tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i dkar chag lo rgyus dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo ārya mai tri na thā ya/ gang 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ chos kyi sgo thams cad nas yul phyogs du mar dar zhing*/ phrin las lhun gyis grub par rgyas pa dang*/ de nyid rgyun mi chad par yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ 'jig rten lugs kyi phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag rang gi ngang gis 'phel ba ni/ spyir dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs ring bsrel gyi snying po can bzhugs pa la rag las pa yin te/ 'di la lung gi sgrub byed dang*/ mngon sum gyi dpe dag las rtogs par bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa'i mchod rten byed dam byed bcug pa// mya ngan 'joms dang lus kun grims pa dang*// rin chen mdzod mang 'jig rten gtsor 'gyur zhing*// mi de dgra yi tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur// bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni// sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci yod pa// de 'dra'i grangs de snyed kyi rgyal srid dang*// lha yul sa stengs mi yis nges par 'thob// gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myong nas// tha mar skye dang rga ba la sogs pa'i// sdug bsngal dang bral sangs rgyas go 'phang thob// 'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa ni// gzugs bzang skal bzang yon tan nye bar ldan// de ni dbang po sbas dang nyi ma'i 'od// 'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' bar 'gyur// bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa gang*// de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang*// nad dang mya ngan 'jigs dang sdug bsngal bral// padma'i nang bzhin 'jam dang yangs par 'gyur// 'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa gang*// bran du mi 'gyur dbul ba'i rang bzhin min// las byed ma yin skye ba dman par min// dbang po ma tshang min te skyes mchog 'gyur// zhes dang*/

slob dpon dpa' bos mdo drangs pa las/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs gsol ba// dang por mya ngan nges par sel// rtsod pa kun spangs mthong na dga'// skal ldan gter tshogs dpal dang ldan// lus stobs ldan zhing snyan pa dang*// gzi brjid ldan zhing gzugs mdzes la// gsung rab kun la mkhas 'gyur zhing*// dbang po'i rta ni thams cad thul// blo ldan gtong dang ldan par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sku gzugs bzhengs nas legs sbyangs la// skye bo gang gis sku bzhengs pa'i// nang du ring bsrel bcug byas na// kun nas brgya byin las 'phags pa'i// mi dbang gling ni bzhi rnams su// dpal dang ldan pas longs spyad nas// mtha' ru rnam dag go 'phang 'thob// ces dang*/ 'dul ba las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bya'o// de la dus ston bya'o// de grong khyer du gshegs par bya'o// sde pa lnga po dag gis zham ring bya'o// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs bya ba chos dang ldan no// zhes dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i gnas su dus ston bya ba chos dang mthun no// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so// gnyis pa mngon sum gyi dpe ni/ gangs can du jo bo shākya mu ne spyan drangs pas/ bstan pa rin po che sgo du ma nas dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ gnyan po gsang ba gnam babs su byon pas gangs can du dge legs dpag med 'phel bar bshad pa bzhin no// gsum po de'i nang nas kyang sku'i rten nyid gtso che ba yin te/ mkhas rmongs mtha' dag dwang ba 'dren pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ba dang*/ rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i gzugs kyi sku bstan pa med na dam pa'i chos gsung ba mi 'byung zhing*/ gsung ba po tshad ma'i skyes bu nyid du go ba yang mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de'i nang nas kyang mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams pa snyigs ma lnga shas che ba'i dus can rnams kyi skyabs kyi dam pa ni mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po nyid yin la/

de'i rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur nas/ dus 'dir mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa med par bzhugs shing*/ ston pa de nyid kyi chos kyi rgyal srid nyams pa mi mnga' bar bzung nas skyong ba ni rgyal ba'i sras po ma pham pa zhes byang phyogs 'di na yang nyi ma ltar grags pa de nyid do// 'di ni thugs bskal pa grangs med pa'i gong rol nas chos kyi sku nyid du rdzogs par byang chub pa las bzhengs pa mi mnga' yang*/ gsung longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnam par rol pas khams dang sa la chags pa dang ma bral ba dag gis kyang bgrod par dka' ba ma yin pa'i chos kyi pho brang dam pa dga' ldan zhes zla ba ltar yongs su grags pa de'i chos kyi khri mthon po la bsti zhing*/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams la nyin mtshan dus drug tu byams pa dang*/ thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs par mdzad do// rje btsun 'dis ni rang cag gi brgyud pa 'di nyid la byin gyis rlobs pa yang yin te/ ma pham g.yag gi mtshan can gyis ni dgung lo sum cu bzhes pa na/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum zhal bton du mdzad pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' las rje btsun gyis zhal dngos su bstan/ phyag brkyang nas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ rje rong chen gyis ni dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis pa'i tshe/ zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas/ ji skad du/ ji ltar nam mkha'i mthas klas kyi// 'gro la rtag tu lhun grub par// thogs med blo ldan de yis ni// sems can don ni yang dag 'jug /ces pa'i gdams pa thob par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ rje a mo gha shrī ni/ byams pa'i chos la mi phyed pa'i dad pa gting brnyes/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i mdo dang sbyar ba thugs la bzhugs/ mdo sde'i rgyan dang*/ rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi don ji lta ba bzhin du sems bzhin pa'i ngang nas tshig lhag ma ma lus par zhal bton du mdzad do// de lta bas na/

rje btsun ma pham pa ni/ ston pa nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pas bstan pa'i 'di'i bdag por gyur pa dang*/ don de nyid kyis na nges pa'i don gyi bstan pa ma nor bar 'dzin pa la thugs rjes brtun pa mi lhod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams ches thag nye ba na bzhugs shing*/ byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa rgyun mi chad pa nyid kyis na/ blo dman pa dag gis kyang ye shes myur du spyan 'dren par sla ba dang*/ brgyud pa gong ma dag gis thugs dam du mdzad cing*/ byin rlabs kyi snang ba rgya cher brnyes pa nyid kyis na/ bcom ldan 'das ma pham pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bkod pa rgyu rin po che las grub pa gang 'dis nye bar bskrun pa la yang rab tu dwang bas 'dun par gyur to// de yang rje a mo gha shrī ni/ sa pho stag gi lo/ rin po che g.yag pas rang lo zhe dgu dang*/ rje rong ston chen pos/ rang lo so gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe sku 'khrungs/ rang lo bdun pa la/ ka lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab las rab tu byung*/ gsung rab mang po'i tshig don la sbyangs pa phul du byung*/ bco brgyad pa la thams cad mkhyen pa rong chen dang mjal gsung rab ma lus pa'i tshig don la sgro 'dogs bcad/ bzad pa blo gros rgya mtsho klog pa pa'i slob dpon du bsten/ nyer lnga pa la yul dbus kyi bshad grwa chen po gsum du ka chen bcu gsum gyi grwa skor mdzad/ mkhyen pa che ba'i grags pas khyab cing*/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dus de tsam nas mtshan nyid theg pa'i bshad nyan gyi dbu btsugs/ bdun cu rtsa bdun gyi bar du nyan bshad kyi mthil mdzad/ de nas mya ngan las 'da' ka'i bar du yang*/ 'dul ba'i mdo dang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan tshar re tsam gsungs/ de dag gi bar skabs snga mo'i dus su/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rked 'phrangs pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mtshal min pa bsod nams bzang po/ glang thang pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan rnams las gsang sngags kyi gsan pa rgya cher mdzad cing*/

dus phyis ngor pa rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga'i mtshan can las spyir gsan pa rgya che zhing*/ khyad par dpal sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi chos la sgro 'dogs ma lus pa chod par mdzad/ phyi mtshan nyid theg pa'i nyan bshad la 'grus pa rgyun ring zhing*/ bu slob bstan pa la phan pa dang*/ grags pa che ba mang du thon/ nang du yang dag 'jog la mi g.yel bas grub chen gyi go 'phang brnyes shing de ltar du grags/ de nas bstan bcos pa ltar na shing pho 'brug gi lo shar/ 'jig rten la grags pa ltar na chu mo yos kyi lo/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la/ dga' ldan gyi gnas su zhi bar gshegs so// de'i dgongs pa zab mo bskang ba'i phyir dang*/ sku tshe gzhan la rje btsun byams pa'i chos kyis 'gro ba mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba sogs/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ chos kyi grwa 'di nyid du bstan pa rin po che'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs par gang ba dang*/ yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten ci nus su bgyi bar 'dun zhing mos pa las/ thog mar shing mo sbrul gyi lo cho 'phrul can yar tshes kyi 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ ne pā la'i bzo rigs pa 'dod pa'i lha las thams cad pas byin gyis brlabs pa rnam pa bzhi

ne pā la/ ya ga la'i grong khyer gyi bzo bo/ dpon mo che'i ming dza ya kirti pā la zhes pa rgyal ba grags pa skyong zhes pa dang*/ zangs mgar ba'i ming na ra singha zhes pa mi'i seng ge dang*/ phra bzo ba'i ming dze ta singha zhes pa rgyal ba seng ge dang*/ 'phul ba'i ming kirti singha grags pa seng ge dang bzhi'o// dag byon nas dbu brtsams te/ me mo lug gis lo hor zla drug pa gro bzhin can gyi phyogs dang po rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor la/ rje btsun gyi sku ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba/ gtsug lag khang rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'di yongs su grub pa'o// 'di la rgyu tshogs kyi tshad dang*/ bzhugs tshul gyi mngon par rtogs pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ gtso bor gyur pa ni gser dang zangs dag yin la/ zangs ni lha sa'i nyag tshad kyi khal nyis brgya dang lnga bcu/ skud gser ni 'gur chen gyi zho bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu/ dngul chu ni zho sum stong dang drug brgya/ gzhan yang*/ zha nye dkar po dang*/ sngon po/ lcags dang*/ tsha la dang*/ phra'i rgyu tshogs rnam grangs mang po dag dang*/ 'ber gyi rgyu tshogs dang*/ sol ba'i tshogs shin tu che ba ma tshang ba med pa rnams ni/ sa skyong ba'i rgyal po dag dang*/ khyim bdag dpal 'byor dang ldan pa dag dang*/ bu slob dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis dad 'dun dang brtun pa mi lhod pas bsgrubs pa yin no// bzo rigs rnam pa bzhi'i 'phral gyi yo byad/ zla ba re la khal brgya'i tshad du bzhag pa dang*/ phugs kyi yon gser zho bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu/ zong zho bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu/ skon dang*/ skyon dang*/ ston rgyab dang*/ gtang rag rnams sdoms pa la zho nyis brgya/ mdor na sku dngos kyi rgyu tshogs dang*/ nang bzhugs kyi rgyu tshogs kyi tshad dang*/ rgyags yon gyi rgyu tshogs kyi tshad rnams mnyam gsum du bzhag pa'o// gnyis pa la/ tshad dang*/ bzhugs stangs dang*/ rab tu gnas pa'o// dang po ni/

rtsom pa po blo sngon du btang ba ni/ ston pa mchog gi sprul sku'i tshad du bgyis pa/ bzo rigs pas cung zad 'phar ba dang bcas pa yin la/ de yang ji skad du/ 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshad// khru bzhi pa dang*/ zhes pas/ skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i sku dngos la rang re'i khru tshad bcu gnyis cung zad 'phar ba la khru gang*/ dbu rgyan gyi dpangs la khru gang dang mtho gang lhag tsam/ gtsug tor dang mchod rten gnyis ka yang de dang tshad mnyam las cung zad lhag tsam/ padma'i dpangs la khru do dang*/ mtho gang lhag tsam dang bcas pa rnams ni zangs gser nyid kyis bsgrubs pa yin la/ khri ni rgyu 'jim pa las grub cing*/ dpangs khru lnga lhag tsam dang bcas par grub pa'o// bzhugs tshul ni/ ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i thog mar seng ge'i khri la sku drang por bsrang ba dang*/ dgongs pa sngon du btang nas/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis phyogs bcu rab 'byams kyi 'khor rnams bsdus/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i rnam rol la gnas nas/ yan lag drug cur tshang ba'i tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'doms par mdzad pa de nyid dang mthun par bsgrubs pa'o// de las dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde sa chen skyong ba'i rgyal po blon por bcas pa rnams sku tshe ring zhing phywa srid brtan pa dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba nyid du grub pa'o// rab tu gnas pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid tshang ba dag gis/ rab tu gnas pa don gsal ba las ji skad gsungs pa'i phyag len dang mthun pa khrums kyis nya ba'i phyogs dang po rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor la grub pa dang*/ de kho nar ma zad/ slad nas 'byon par 'gyur ba'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ gang zag khyad par can so so dang bcas pa dag gis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa dang brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba rgyun mi chad pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur la/

de'i tshe na gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sngon gyi smon lam/ 'phral dang yun gyi thugs rje'i dbang gis ye shes kyi 'khor lo rtag par 'jug pa ni/ rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo dag dang*/ dbyar dus kyi char sprin stug po las char gyi tshogs bzhin no// gang 'di'i dri gtsang khang gi ngo bo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam snang gi ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ kun rdzob kyi rnam pa khang bzangs mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya mtshos rnam par brgyan pa 'di yang rtag tu dge ba dang*/ yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir du/ gtsang khang du gnas pa'i slob dpon bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa/ 'dul ba'i sde snod legs par shes shing*/ rje btsun byams pa'i chos lnga kha bton du 'don pa zhig la/ ji ltar 'tshams pa'i g.yog dang bcas te/ rtag tu gnas par gsol dgos pa la/ de'i zas dang gos kyi 'tsho ba ni sa skyong rgyal po'i bla nas sbyor ba dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong nye 'khor dang bcas pa na bzhugs pa'i yon gyi bdag po rnams kyis bsgrub par bya ba yin no// dga' ldan khang bzangs mdzes pa'i nyi ma ni// 'dzam gling 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dpal du shar// byams dang snying rje 'od phreng drwa ba yis// phan bde'i lo 'bras rgyas pa'i bkra shis spyon// de ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang bstan bsrungs rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang zhing*/ bsrungs pa'i rang re'i chos kyi grwa dam pa 'di ni/ thog mar rje a mo gha nyid gsang phu ne'u thog gi 'chad nyan gyi rgyun nyung shas dag dang bcas te/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par bzhugs pa'i tshe/ byams chen chos kyi rje dang*/ sa skyong nor bu bzang po yon mchod kyi bka' bgro bas/ chu pho spre'u'i lo la brag dmar gyi chos sder 'chad nyan pa'i go sar spyan drangs/ paṇa gyi khyung tshang du chos bar la phebs pa na/

yul pa rnams kyi dad mos dang*/ khyad par rgya gan nang pas zi lung gi gnas dang mthun rkyen phul/ star chags su gdan chags pa la brten nas bshad pa'i grwa tshugs pa yin no// de nas lo nyi shu pa lcags mo yos kyi lo hor zla dang po la rang res gnas 'dir slebs/ nyan bshad kyi go cha blangs/ de nas lo lnga lon pa shin mo lug gi lo/ hor zla bzhi pa yan chod du/ gnas sa phug pa la brten pa las gzhan med la/ dus der spong khang ka ba drug gi sa blo 'bur dang bcas pa rgya gan nang pas bzhengs/ de nas lo gnyis pa me pho spre'u la/ yul pa rnams kyis kun dga' rwa ba ka ba sum cu rtsa bzhi/ rung khang zung 'brel dang bcas pa bzhengs/ de nas lo bcu pa shing mo sbrul nas/ me mo lug gi bar lo gsum po la/ rje btsun ma pham pa'i gzugs sku ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta/ dga' ldan chos kyi lha khang dang bcas pa bsgrubs so// de bas na sa phyogs 'dir bstan pa'i rgyun yun ring du gnas par gyur cig pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ chos skyong bsrungs ma rnams kyi mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings la bya byed rung ba'i stobs kyis/ ji ltar smon pa de dag de kho na ltar 'gyur ba nyid du nges pas/ slad nas chos kyi grwa 'di nyid du 'byon pa dang*/ zhabs brtan par bzhugs pa rnams kyis 'di ltar shes dgos te/ thos bsam gyi 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i gnas gser mdog can du mtshan gsol ba 'di ni/ spyir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lugs kyi chos kyi grwa/ phar phyin gyi bshad rgyun rngog lo tstsha ba nas/ bu ston rin po che'i bar du brgyud/ de la mi pham g.yag gis zhus nas/ rong chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du brgyud pa de yin/ rnam 'grel gyi bshad rgyun/ kha che paṇa chen nas/ sa skya paṇḍi ta la brgyud/ dga' ldan gyi mkhan po brtson 'grus dpal la rin po che g.yag pas gsan nas de la rong chen gyis zhus pa de yin/

tshad bsdus kyi bshad rgyun rgyan dang*/ chos mchog sogs kha 'thor nas bsdus pa/ phywa rtsang sogs kyis srol gtod pa yin la/ de'i nang nas mi rigs pa rnams dor/ rigs pa rnams thad sor bzhag nas mdo sems dang mthun par 'chad pa ni tshad ma rigs pa'i gter yin/ grwa 'dir tshad ma 'chad pa rnams kyis rigs pa'i gter gyi lam srang las gzhan du mi 'da' bar 'chad dgos/ dka' 'grel/ rtog ge'i 'khrul 'joms/ rtog ge'i snying po rnams kyis lugs de dpyis phyin par bshad na gzhan du skad cig kyang 'das pa med/ phar phyin gyi bshad pa rje gong ma gnyis kyi lugs gang du bshad kyang blo mtho ba rnams la khyad par med mod/ rje a mo ghas rong chen pa'i lugs nyid gsungs/ rang res kyang rong ṭīka nyid kyi 'chad thabs su/ yan lag rgyas bshad/ ngag don bsdus pa/ dka' 'grel rgyas pa rnams ni/ rnam bshad las gzhan du 'da' ba med pas de ltar 'chad dgos/ lung rigs rol mtsho dang*/ lung chos snying po rnams su ni rje gong ma gnyis kyi bshad pa gang rung gcig tu ma nges shing*/ so so'i skabs su gang bab dang*/ gong mas ma gsungs pa kha cig rgyas par kha bskang nas yod pas blo mtho ba rnams la de ltar yang 'gal ba med/ dbu ma'i bshad srol/ pa tshab nas/ zhang thag sag pa la brgyud pa rong chen gyi gsan pa de yin/ rang res rgyas par bshad pa de ni sngon bod yul du byon pa snga ma rnams dang lta ba mthun/ khyad par rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo dang*/ grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bzhed pa de nyid rtsa bar bzung nas/ gangs can du phyis dar ba'i lugs mkhas rmongs kun la me ltar mched pa 'di dang ma 'dres par 'chad pa yin/ 'dul mdzod kyi bshad rgyun/ skyor mo lung pa dang*/ gro sa'i dmar ston las brgyud pa mi 'dra ba gnyis yin/ byams chos phyi ma'i bshad rgyud/ rngog lo chen po nas brgyud pa de nyid gtso bo yin zhing*/ lta ba'i thad du/

btsan kha bo che la byams chos sgom lugs ltar 'chad pa zhes bya ba zhig byung bar grags pa de bod na bzhed pa yang mang zhing*/ de nyid 'khor lo phyi ma'i nges don du go bas rang res kyang de ltar du bshad pa yin/ mngon pa gong ma'i bshad srol/ dpang lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa de bzad pa blo gros rgya mtshos gsan nas/ mkhas pa phul du phyin par gyur pa de la rje a mo ghas gsan pa yin/ mdor na/ byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shur grags pa de'i mthar thug gi dgongs pa dbu ma chen por 'grel ba 'di la bsnyengs pa med pa'i gdeng khel bar byas pa las/ rje btsun ma pham pa mchog tu dgyes pa grub pa yin no// de ltar na chos kyi grwa 'dir dge 'dun gyi tshogs mang nyung ji ltar bzhugs kyang rung*/ gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gal che bas/ rnam thar dang tshugs chos pa spyi la grags pa rnams gzhir bzhag 'dul ba'i nyan bshad/ gzhi gsum gyi cho ga lag len phran tshegs kyis brgyan pa rnams ma nyams par bya/ slob ma bsdu ba dang*/ longs spyod 'phel ba la phrin las kyi tshogs gzhan dang gzhan dag 'jems pa lta bur snang yang*/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa dang*/ mkhas pa 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni/ sde snod kyi nyan bshad kho na la rag las pas de ltar mdzad dgos/ de las ni/ rgyud sde nas 'byung ba'i lam gyi bgrod tshul yang lung tsam thos pa las kyang ngang gis shes pa 'byung*/ de ltar na grwa sa 'dir/ gnas brtan gtso bo nas chos smra ba dang nyan pa'i bar thams cad kyis/ sa skya pa la grags pa'i chos che chung*/ lag len phran tshegs kyis mtha' brten pa yan chad la nan tan du bya zhing*/ de'i tshul yang*/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid/ spyir rje btsun sa skya pa'i phrin las las 'khrungs shing*/ khyad par rang re 'di pa la lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas/ de nyid kyi bshad srol dang*/ phyag len ji lta ba bzhin du byed dgos/

yang de las gzhan gangs can du brgyud pa rnam par dag pa khungs thub can mang po yod pa rnams la/ rje rong chen la mnga' ba dang*/ rje a mo gha nyid la mnga' ba dang*/ rang res kyang bla ma so so brgyud pa mi 'dra ba du ma nas byung ba thos pa rnams 'dzin nus pa dag byung na/ zhar las byung ba'i tshul gyis/ thos bsam dang sgrub pa'i 'khor lo gnyis kyis nyams su blang par bya'o// 'gro kun bde la sbyor ba byams pa'i sku// kun gyi sdug bsngal skyob pa snying rje'i gsung*// yongs kyi bde ba bsrung mdzad dga' ba'i thugs// snyoms shing lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las spyon// rang re'i chos kyi grwa gang du btab pa'i gnas 'di ni dge mtshan dang ldan pa zhig ste/ rgyab kyi ri bo lhun stug cing byin chags la/ rtse mo mtho bar thon/ 'phags yul gyi ri bo zam ma chad pa'i gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i ri rgyud bar ma chad/ mdun phyogs kyi ri bo mang po rgyang ring po na gus pas 'dud/ nyang yul gyi chu bo dang*/ shab kyi chu bo dang*/ la stod grom pa'i chu bo gsum ni/ thog mar shar gyi mthar thug nas 'ongs/ lho dang nub la rim gyis brgyud/ byang phyogs su rtsang chu chen po dang 'dres/ yul phyogs 'di'i thad kyi g.yas skor du 'khor zhing 'khyil/ yul 'di pa'i pha mthar slebs pa ni/ slar yang gyen du 'khyil te dung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i rnam pa can du snang ba'o// dge mtshan gyi 'bras bu dus su smin pa yang dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzhugs pa la rag las shing*/ de las byin rlabs kyi char 'byung ba yang dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pa yin te/ bkra shis kyi gnas su yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'byung zhing*/ de las 'dod rgu 'byung ba/ dri ma sbyong byed kyi thabs dang*/ gsol gdab tshul bzhin du shes pa'i ded dpon la rag las pa bzhin no// de bas na grwa 'dir seng ge'i khri la 'khod nas dam pa'i chos 'chad pa po/

mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi che ba dang ldan pa gzhir bzhag de lta na yang rgyang ring po'i snyan grags dang*/ bkur bsti ba'i gnas mthon po thob pa sogs gtso bor gyur pa ma yin gyi/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan sems che ba dang*/ rnyed pa dang bkur bsti 'tshol ba'i phyir zhugs pa ma yin par/ dam pa'i chos 'chad pa las mi g.yel ba dang*/ bya ba'i mgo brtsams nas mtha' skyong ba la blo brtan zhing sgrin pa dang*/ dam tshig bsrung zhing gong du bshad pa'i chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin zhing skyong ba la gzhol ba dag ko na rtag par bya ba yin no// //snyan grags sprin gyi bu mo bzhad ldan ma// legs bshad glog phreng skyod pa'i rol rtsed mkhan// phrin las char chen dus su 'bebs pa ni// mi pham srid zhi'i dbang phyug des skyongs shig /rje btsun ma pham pa'i chos lngar grags pa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dngos yin kyang*/ bstan bcos kyi tshul du mdzad pas sgra ji bzhin pa nyid du khas blangs pas chog chos lnga ka'i lta ba dbu mar gnas pa la khyad med/ de lta na yang*/ ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i lta ba dang 'jog tshul mi 'dra/ rgyud bla ma'i lta ba de ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i lta ba kho na yin zhes zer ba de gangs can du phyis byung ba yin/ lnga po'i don dam med dgag gi cha la 'chad pa rngog lo'i brgyud pa la byung*/ de lta na yang thal rang gi tshul du mi 'brel/ don dam ye shes kyi cha la 'chad pa btsan kha bo che'i lugs yin zhing*/ de nyid thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung dang mthun/ bod du slob dpon zla ba'i gzhung ma dar gong du byams chos phyi ma'i lta ba la sems tsam zer ba ma byung zhing*/ zhi byed dang rdzogs chen/ phyag rgya ba'i lta ba rnams byams chos phyi ma ltar 'chad/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs gsang sngags bla med kyi lta ba yang 'di kho na ltar nges/ slob dpon zla ba'i sgron gsal du yang 'di nyid bzhed/

tshig gsal dang sgron gsal du lugs mi 'dra ba de ltar 'byung ba yang*/ mtshan nyid theg pa rkyang pas lam bgrod pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pas lam bgrod pa'i khyad par las 'byung ba yin no// slob dpon zla bas dbyig gnyen gyi lta ba sems tsam du 'chad pa dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyis gcig shos skur 'debs kyi lta bar bshad pa lta bur snang*/ bod yul du phyis byon pa'i chen po dag kyang*/ phyogs 'dzin gyi dbang gyis de ltar bzhed mod/ yang dag pa ma yin/ des na thal rang gi lta ba dbu mar ni legs par grub zin pas sgrub mi dgos la/ byams chos phyi ma'i lta ba dbu mar ni rje btsun nyid kyi lung gis grub pa dang*/ de nyid dgongs pa can du 'grel ba'i tshad ldan su yang med pa'i lung las dang*/ 'byed rnam gnyis kyi lta ba rgyud bla'i lta ba dang khyad par med par mngon sum gyis grub cing*/ de las dbu mar grub pa ni kun mthun pa dang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes zhes bya ba yang*/ dbus mtha' dang sum cu pa'i rab tu byed pa las 'byung ba 'di nyid las gzhan du 'chad mi nus pa dang*/ klu sgrub zhabs kyis chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa dang*/ sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel las 'byung ba'i lta ba dang*/ byams chos phyi ma'i lta ba khyad par ma mchis shing*/ de las dbu mar grub pa ni/ kun mthun pa'i phyir ro// zhes bya ba 'di ni byams pa'i chos lnga theg pa kun gyi rtse mor grub pa'o// //ma pham sku yis dwang ba 'dren pa dang*// de'i gsung dbu ma'i lam du grub pa dang*// khyod thugs rgyal ba mchog gi rgyal tshab ces// bsngags 'os 'di gsum phan tshun nges pa 'dren// ma pham sku yi ya mtshan ltad mo ni// kun gyi dad 'dun 'dren pa'i shing rtar nges// de'i gsung legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston ni// thub bstan ring du 'tsho ba'i bdud rtsir nges// de ltar grub pa'i dge tshogs dpag bsam shing*// nor 'dzin bcud mang 'thung ba'i rtsa lag dang*// phan bde'i lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas pa gang*// thub bstan bsti ba'i gnas su 'di gyur cig

/ces pa rje btsun mi pham mgon// dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen gang de yis// mchod par phul ba'i yi ge pa// blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// ༈ //nang bzhugs kyi dkar chag/ ༄// rje btsun ma pham pa'i rten rin po che las grub pa'i gzungs bzhugs kyi rim pa dkar chag tu btab pa/ swasti pra dzā bhyaḥ kun la snyoms mkhas bde chen ye shes nyin mor byed pa'i mdangs gsal ba de yis// 'gro 'dir kun dga' gsar pa'i sbrang rtsi smin pa 'di ni bgrang yas 'gro ba yi// mi bzad sdug bsngal 'phrog byed snying rje'i bung ba las yin de yang myur bar ni// mgron du 'gugs byed byams pa'i skyed tshal 'di ni mang po'i dpag bsam ljon pa yin// rgyal dang de sras slob mar ni// bcas pa kho nar ma zad kyi// yid ldan kun gyi rang gzhan la// phan par bsams pa ci yod kun// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis// ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba// 'gro ba mang po'i bsod nams kyi// zhing du 'khrungs la phyag bgyi'o// gang 'dir skye dgu rnams sdug bsngal gyi chu gter chen po las sgral nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i lam chen por 'jug pa dang*/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i khang bzang chen por chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang mthon po la bsti zhing rol bar byed pa'i mdzad pa dus las mi 'dab ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa zhes nyi ma ltar grags pa de yin la/ de nyid sa phyogs gang du 'phel zhing rgyas pa yang*/ de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa dag 'byung ba la rag las shing*/ de yang rgyal ba nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas der/ rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo dag bzhin du rang gis ngang gis 'dus nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho chen por rim gyis gang bar gsungs so// de'i phyir rje btsun ma pham pa 'di ni/ thugs bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi sku'i ngo bo las g.yo ba med cing*/

gsung longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnam rol mtha' yas pas/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba la longs spyod pa rgyun mi gcod/ sku byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul du bstan nas thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba de deng sang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa med par bzhugs pa ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nas dpag tshad sum 'bum dang nyi khris gyen du 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang dam pa dga' ldan zhes yongs su grags pa de'i chos kyi khri la bsti bar mdzad nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams la gzigs pa rnam pa drug gis rgyun mi chad par gzigs pa de nyid do// de'i phyir gnas bkra shis kyi gtsug lag khang thub bstan gser mdog can zhes bya ba'i chos kyi khri yangs po'i dbus su/ rje btsun mchog gi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bkod pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba can/ rgyu rin po che las bsgrubs na/ legs par grub pa ring srel gyi snying po can du ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa rnams brjod par bya'o// byin rlabs char chen dus su nges phebs shing*// phrin las chu chen rtag tu 'bebs brtson pa// phan dang bde ba'i yid bzhin mtsho chen por// bstan gsum rin chen tshogs kyi bkra shis spyon// //thog mar dbu'i gtsug tor rang byung mchod rten gyi rnam par grub pa'i nang na/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ gsang sngags bla med kyi gzungs rgyas pa/ mchod rten gyi gzungs ji snyed pa gser gyis bris pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ring srel/ rje btsun grags pa'i ring srel/ sa paṇa gyi ring srel/ 'phags pa rin po che'i dbu skra/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i na bza'i dum bu/ theg chen chos rje'i na bza'i dum bu/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gdung tshwa/ hor ka bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi gdung tshwa/ byang chub kyi shing rnams bzhugs/ rje btsun chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// mtshon byed gtsug tor dbus su chos sku'i rten// mtshan nyid ma lus rdzogs pa'i gzi 'bar bas// gang la ci dga' dngos grub deng 'dir stsol//

//dbu'i nang gi srog shing la/ rgya bod kyi bla ma dam pa phal che ba rnams kyi mtshan gzungs/ lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi rigs sngags rgyas pa gser gyis bris te bzhugs/ srog shing de'i rtse mo'i khang bzangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring srel re re bzhugs pa'i tsandan dkar po'i mchod rten brgyad/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing gi 'bras bu chos lung tshogs pa nas byung ba/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing gi tshal bu dang lo ma rten bzhengs dus rgya gar pu kang nas byon pa'i dge slong gis bsnams byung ba sangs rgyas kyi ring srel bzhi bcu tham pa/ rje btsun grags pa'i ring srel gcig sa paṇa gyi ring srel gcig po to ba'i ring srel gcig ka ma la shī la'i na bza'/ bla ma dam pa'i na bza' dang gdung*/ nā ro pa'i rgyan drug gi dum bu/ kha che paṇa chen gyi sku gdung*/ lo chen rin bzang gi bum chu ril bu/ na bza' brag phug pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ rje btsun mi la'i dbu lo/ bu ston pa'i dbu lo/ 'ba' ra ba'i dbu lo/ bcom ldan ral gri'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ bla ma dam pa'i dbu lo/ mkhas pa lung mang po'i dbu lo/ g.yung ston pa'i dbu lo/ rgyal sras thogs med kyi dbu lo/ 'brom ston pa'i dbu lo dang sku rags kyi dum bu/ lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi na bza'i dum bu/ sne'u zur pa'i dbu lo/ bya 'chad ka ba'i gdung rus/ mchims nam mkha' grags pa'i tshems kyi dum bu/ mchims blo bzang grags pa'i dbu lo/ sne'u zur pa'i gdung*/ ram sding ma ba'i ring srel/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa'i shangs mtshal/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba'i dbu lo/ rgya gar phyag na'i ring srel/ dwags po bkras rnam pa'i ring srel/ rgyal sras chos rdzong pa'i thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten sangs rgyas kyi ring srel can gcig rje rdo rje 'chang gi gdung tshwa gsum rnams bzhugs/ mdzod spu dang spyan la sogs pa'i skye mched so so na rang rang gi gzungs sngags gser gyis bris pa/

dbu'i 'khor khyams che sa na/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i a ka ru dang tsandan dkar po las grub pa rje btsun ring srel gyi snying po can byams bzhugs su mdzad pa'i g.yas na/ rje btsun nyid kyi sku zi khyim las grub pa mtho gang pa/ g.yon na tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje'i thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma tsandan dkar po las grub pa sangs rgyas kyi ring srel can/ pa tshab lo tsās rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i gdung rten khyad par can nang so rgya ma pas phul ba rnams/ sman gyi phur ma dang dri bzang gis mchod pa khang bzangs dang bcas te bzhugs/ zhal gyi thad kar dung dkar gyi lto bar zhal gyi gzungs su bshad pa rnams dang*/ byang chub kyi shing gi dum bu/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i dbu skra/ rje btsun grags pa'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ sa paṇa gyi dbu skra/ byang sems zla rgyal gyi snam sbyar gyi tshal bu/ grub chen spyang lung pa'i dbu skra/ gur mgon gyi rus rgyan gyi dum bu/ yang byin brlabs de rnams bsres pa'i gdung tshwa gsum/ yum bsdud pa la sogs pa'i mdo phran gser ma thog gcig bzhugs/ yid 'ongs lang tsho 'bar ba'i zhal gyi mdangs/ legs bshad sbrang rtsi 'bab pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis/ bsod nams shing rta 'dren pa'i kha lo pa/ ngo mtshar dwang ba 'dren pa'i bkra shis spyon// //mgrin pa'i thad kar na/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i byams chos gser ma/ bde kyai gsang gsum la sogs pa'i rgyud tshan nyi shu skor gyi glegs bam/ yum brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam rgya dpe gnyis/ 'jam bsdud bzang gsum gser ma tshar gsum/ gzungs 'bum rgyas pa'i glegs bam chen mo/ dung dkar gnyis kyi nang na byin rlabs sna tshogs bcug pa rnams bzhugs/ mgrin pa'i 'og tsam gyi khang bzang gcig na/ rdo rje 'chang gi gser sku drug rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i li sku gnyis/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gser sku/

rje pham mo gru pa'i dngul gar blugs kyi sku/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma zhang*/ rje bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gser sku re re/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i gser sku/ tsandan las grub pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po/ yang mi g.yo ba dkar po'i li sku khyad par can zhig mi g.yo ba sngon po'i li sku gnyis/ mtshan brjod gser ma gsum/ bsdud pa gser ma gcig bzang spyod dang rnam 'joms gser ma re re/ tshe mdo tshar bcu bdun/ byang chub shing gi 'dab ma gcig rong chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu zhu gnyis/ spyan ras gzigs kyi li sku gcig rnams la/ 'bru dang rin po che sna tshang*/ sman dang gos dar sna tshogs/ gan spos a kar tsandan la sogs pa'i spos sna tshang gi mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs/ ji lta'i don la chags pa mi mnga' yang*// ji snyed gsung la thogs pa med gyur pas// bdud dang rgol ba'i khengs pa kun 'phrog pa// mgrin par chos sgra sgrogs pa'i bkra shis spyon// //thugs dka'i dkyil drang thad kyi srong shing la/ rje btsun sa skya paṇḍi ta'i sku gdung hor yul nas spyan drangs pa'i gdung sgrom lcags las byas pa'i tshags gser ma gru bzhi/ dpangs khru gang tsam yod pa/ logs bzhi la rgyal chen sde bzhi rang rang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba dang bcas pa brkos su byas pa'i nang na/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung ring srel stong phrag lhag tsam gyi gong bur gyur pa/ po to ba'i ring srel gsum/ jo bo'i rje'i phyag tshwa gcig ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gi gdung tshwa bdun/ na bza' ber thul gyi dum bu/ byang chub shing gi dum bu 'khyud gang ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rnams kyi gdung tshwa re/ rje rong chen po'i phyag tu lo drug cu tsam bcangs pa'i phyag dam/ rje a mo gha nyid kyi phyag dam dang bcas pa la/ gser/ dngul/ g.yu/ mu men/ mu tig gzhan yang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i sil mas gtams pa/

gos dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang bcas pa/ byi ru'i sdong po yal ga bcu gsum pa/ tsandan dkar po'i tshal pa chen po gnyis/ a ka ru/ kaspu ra/ sihla li shing*/ dzā ti/ kuṅkum/ gan spos reng bu la sogs pa'i spos dang sman sna tshogs par bcas te bzhugs// //yang thugs ka'i mdun drang thad na bzhugs pa'i lha khang na/ tog la rje btsun gyi ring srel gnyis/ sa paṇa gyi ring srel gcig bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i ring srel gcig gzungs zab mo gser gyis bris pa rnams so// chos 'khor gyi nang na/ bdag po sog 'phags pas phul ba'i gdung rten rgya gar ma gcig khang bzang na nang so don yod pas phul ba'i ston pa'i sku zi khyim las grub pa khyad par can/ lam 'bras pa blo bzang gis thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i dngul gar blugs kyi snying po kyai rdo rje'i sku 'dzub gang ba la lha mo brgyad kyi gser skus bskor ba/ nang so hor shāka pa'i phyag tu byung ba rje rin po che nyid kyi drung du phul ba de dang*/ dngul gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten mtho gang pa lo tsā ba skyabs mchog gi thugs dam nang so hor shāka pa'i phyag tu byung ba dang*/ zi khyim las grub pa'i gdung rten rgya gar ma gcig rje btsun birwa pa/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi sku re re/ bsam rtse nas nang so'i drung gis phul ba'i li kar gyi byams pa'i sku khyad par can gcig 'jam dbyangs kyi sku gcig thugs ka'i gzungs su bshad pa gser gyis bris pa rnams dang*/ rin po che dang*/ 'bras bu sna tshogs dang*/ gan spos kyi reng bu dang*/ spos sna tshogs pa'i phur mas gtams pa dang bcas te bzhugs// //yang thugs ka'i g.yas phyogs kyi khang bzang na/ ston pa'i gser sku sum cu so gsum/ bsdud pa gser ma tshar gsum/ bzang spyod gser ma tshar gnyis/ mtshan brjod tshar sum cu so gcig byang chub shing gi 'dab ma gcig sman bla'i bris sku gnyis/

sman bla'i mdo dang mdo chog tshar gsum/ rin po che/ sman/ 'bru/ dar zab/ spos sna tshogs kyi phur mas gtams pa bzhugs// //yang thugs ka'i g.yon phyogs kyi khang bzang na/ tshe dpag med kyi gser sku bcu gsum/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gser sku gnyis/ bskal bzang nas 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan 'bum gser dngul gyi bris pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'bum rgyas pa mdo gzhan las 'byung ba dang*/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod gser ma tshar bcu/ rgyal po mdo lnga/ dri med kyi gzungs mdo sogs mdo phran mang po'i glegs bam gcig rnams/ sman dang 'bru dang rin po che sna tshogs dang bcas te bzhugs// //yang thugs ka'i g.yas logs kyi khang bzang gcig na/ ston pa'i sku li ma gcig 'jam dbyangs kyi li sku khyad par can bzhi/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gser sku gsum/ tshe dpag med kyi gser sku gnyis/ rje btsun byams pa'i gser sku lnga/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya yul ba'i thugs dam dngul gar blugs kyi sgrol ma mtho gang pa la/ sgrol ma'i gser sku bcu gcig gi bskor ba/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i li sku gnyis/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi li sku gcig rnams/ rin po che sna lnga dang*/ sman sna dang*/ dar zab la sogs pa dang bcas te bzhugs// //yang thugs ka'i g.yon logs kyi dung dkar zhig gi nang na/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing gi dum bu/ bya rgod phung po'i rdo/ rgya gar gyi gnas phal cher gyi sa sna bsdus pa'i ril bu/ bsam yas mchod rten sngon po'i rdo/ rwa sgreng gi mchod brgya rtsa'i sa/ rwa sgreng gi chu mig rnams kyi chu sna bsdus pa'i ril bu/ dbus gtsang gi rten byin brlabs can phal cher gyi rdul sna 'dus pa'i ril bu/ rwa sgreng gi shug pa'i 'bras bu/ rgya ma rin chen sgang pa'i sngags 'dam/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i rtswa dang rdo/ snar thang gi byams pa'i rten 'dam byin rlabs can/ yang rgya bod kyi lha byin rlabs can mang po'i rdul sna bsdus pa'i ril bu/

sa skya pa'i bum chu ril bu/ nyug pa dbon po'i phyag nas byung ba'i byin rlabs can stong rtsa'i ril bu bzhugs// //yang thugs ka'i khang bzangs so so'i bar mtshams na/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po nas na bza' mkhred gsol gyi bar mkhan rabs gsum ma nyams par brgyud pa'i gos chen zi hun gyi snam sbyar gcig sangs rgyas kyi ring srel bzhugs par grags pa'i gdung rten char khebs ma khru gang pa gcig gzhan gdung rten bcu gsum/ yang ston pa dang spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi li sku bcu phrag gcig rnams bzhugs/ grub pa mchog gi nam yang mi slu zhing*// thun mong dngos grub ring nas 'gugs byed pa'i// yon tan kun rdzogs thugs kyi yid bzhin mtsho// yon tan 'phrin las rgyas pa'i bkra shis spyon// //sku'i sta zur yan chod na/ gser gyi glegs bam sum cu tham pa bzhugs pa la/ yum 'phags pa brgyad stong pa nyi shu rtsa bdun/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa/ gser 'od bam po bcu pa/ sman mdo dang mngon pa kun las btus sogs kyi glegs bam/ yum nyi shu lnga pa dkar po tshar gcig brgyad stong pa dkar po tshar bcu gnyis/ ka chen bzhi sogs gzung phran lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs/ sku'i dkyil 'khor cha shas kun gang zhing*// gsung gi bsil zer bka' dang bstan bcos kyi// 'od zer stong phrag 'phro ba'i snang byed des// thugs kyi rdo rje dge shing bkra shis shog /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa'i dbus thad na/ dpa' bo grub pa'i brgyud las 'byung ba'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ 'bri thabs rje btsun grags pa'i dgongs pa/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis blangs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ zangs kyi glegs bu la gser gyis bris pa/ man ngag gi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrubs shing kha ra dang sbrang rtsi la sogs pas byur bur bltams pa dang*/ dung dkar la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams kyi mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs/

de'i steng na dzambha la ser po'i gser sku khru gang pa gcig dang*/ dzambha la'i li sku sor bzhi pa gcig bzhugs/ de'i thad kyi srog shing la chos skyong bod du 'gyur tshad kyi gzungs/ phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen sde bzhi'i gzungs/ mdo dang rgyud sde mang po las 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgyas pa rnams bzhugs/ de'i steng na/ 'phags pa rin po che'i rab gnas bzhugs pa'i gur mgon lha brgyad kyi bris sku/ rje rdo rje 'chang dang*/ mkhas grub spyang lung pa'i phyag zhabs kyi rjes zung re/ de dag gi 'gram na/ rje rong chen pa'i gsol lhung 'bru sna tshogs dang bcas/ ja bzang po dang*/ rin po che dang*/ dri dang sman sna tshogs kyis gtams pa bzhugs/ zhabs g.yas g.yon gyi nang khongs na/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dkar po tshar gnyis/ gzungs kyi glegs bam tshar brgyad/ zhabs lha nga'i thad na gser gyi glegs bam khyad par can re re bzhugs pa rnams la/ sman dang dri bzang po'i phur ma dang*/ des sbags pa'i ras ser po'i na bza' dang bcas pa/ brla dang*/ byin pa dang*/ zhabs mthil dang*/ sor mo rnams la/ so so'i gzungs su ji skad bshad pa rnams bzhugs// //padma so so'i 'dab ma la/ so so'i gzungs su bshad pa rnams bzhugs/ padma'i nang khongs kyi khang bzangs na/ 'bru sna tshogs kyi gang ba dang*/ bkra shis pa'i sa phyogs dang*/ byin rlabs che ba'i gnas nas bsdus pa'i sa sna rnams kyi shis par byas te bzhugs so// byams dang thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'thug po las// dngos grub rnam gnyis bdud rtsi'i zim char gyis// gang la ci dga'i rgya mtsho khengs mdzad pa// mchog dang thun mong byed po'i bkra shis spyon// //'dir bu ston rin po ches zhus dag par mdzad pa'i gzungs 'bum chen mo nyid la phyi mo bgyis te/ gser gyis bris pa dang*/ rje a mo gha nyid kyi gdung rus kyis bris pa dang*/ dkar por bris pa ste tshan gsum bzhugs pa dang*/

gzhan yang chos sde so so na gzungs gzhug gi rim pa nyid du bsngos nas par du btab pa dag dang tshan pa bzhi bzhugs su gsol ba las/ gzungs dang ring srel 'jug pa'i go rim/ gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas/ skye mched so so'i gzungs dang bcas pa/ rje btsun gyi rab gnas don gsal dang*/ dpang lo chen pos mdzad pa dang*/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gis gser sku rdo rje 'chang du sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan du gsol ba'i phyag len mdzad pa rnams gzhir bzhag nas/ me mo lug gi lo/ khrums kyis nya ba'i zla ba/ rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la legs par grub pa'o// gang 'di'i khri dang padma nas// gtsug tor nor bu 'bar ba'i bar// ring srel yungs 'bru tsam zhig gam// rgyal ba'i bka' dang gzungs kyi tshig /shlau ka tsam bzhugs gsol dang*// rin chen sman sogs chung ngu nas// rgya che'i bar du sbyor mdzad pa'i// lhag bsam dag pa'i sa skyong dang*// dge sbyong bram ze khyim bdag dang*// rgyal po'i snang chen la sogs pa// yon gyi bdag po gang yod dang*// 'di yi lag len tshul bzhin du// skrun byed chos kyi rgyal mtshan kyang*// gnas skabs byams pa'i zhal bzang las// gsung rab sbrang rtsi 'thung ba dang*// ma rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// sgrol la gegs byed med par shog /sems can thams cad bde 'dod pa'i// byams pa sgrib kun dang bral ba// ye shes nyi ma cher 'bar bas// bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par shog /gang la ci dga'i dngos grub kyi// byin brlabs 'od stong spro mdzad des// 'jig rten pa kun bde ba dang*// tshe ring 'byor pas gang bar mdzod// khrums kyis nya ba'i bco lnga la// rje btsun dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen gyi// ring srel bzhugs tshul brjed byang du// bkod pas dang ba 'dren byed shog/ // ༄// swasti/ ji lta'i don la chags med 'jam pa'i thugs// ji snyed chos kun thogs med gsung ba'i dbyangs// yid 'phrog dad pa'i shing rta 'dren mdzad sku// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khyod kyis 'dir skyongs shig

/ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir rje btsun de'i sku dad pa'i shing rta 'dren byed 'di ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ces mtshan yongs su grags pa gang gis dgongs pa zab mo yongs su bskang ba'i don gyi phyir/ dpal gser mdog can gyi bla brang nas bzhengs pa'i/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku'i tshad rgyab mtho bco brgyad/ rgyu tshogs kyi tshad zangs khal bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ skud gser mgur chen gyi zho brgya nyi shu/ rgyags kyi tshad/ bzo rigs mkhas pa tsant+ra sogs rnam pa bzhis zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pa la/ nas khal nyi shu rtsa bdun pa dang*/ sha khog bcu phrag pa dang*/ ja nyag drug pa dang*/ mar khal gsum re dang*/ dus bzang ston mo gsum re dang*/ thab ja sbyor gsum re dang*/ lha mchod pa'i dar kha re rnams zla ba re re bzhin du bsgrubs/ yon la gser ngo bo mgur chen bzhi bcu/ rnga dkar gshags mdom bdun cu/ gos phyi nang tshang ma gsum/ bskon la gos chen phu dung ma re/ bskyon la rta re/ rab tu gnas pa'i tshad/ dbu'i gtsug tor gyi srog shing la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring srel/ rje btsun grags pa'i 'phel gdung*/ gsung ngag rin po che dang*/ bde dgyes la sogs pa bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum gan shog gi steng du gser gyis bris pa/ srog shing ngo bo la gzungs 'bum chen mo cha tshang dkar po dang*/ chung ba gser dngul gyis bris pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta'i phyag ris gan shog la gser gyis lañdzar bris pa/ bde mchog rgyud kyi dum bu/ sku'i stod kyi cha la/ rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs kyi dgung lo bzhi bcu tsam bzhes pa'i dus kyi sku 'dra bris sku/ gsal la pa dbang phyug grags kyi bzhengs pa/ rje btsun nyid mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar gzims khang de nyid du bzhugs pa/ yar klungs pa se sgom chen po'i phyag nas rim par brgyud de/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi phyag tu byung ba de bzhugs/

thugs ka'i thad na/ mi g.yo dkar po'i sku rgya gar ma/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sne'u zur pa'i thugs dam/ rgya ma gzims chung nas spyan drangs pa de bzhugs// //thugs rje'i spyan gyis ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bsrungs// byams pa'i phyag gis bde ba'i gnas su 'dren// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las 'gong mdzad pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid la mgos phyag 'tshal// zhes mchod par brjod nas/ rje btsun 'jig rten dbang po'i sku tshad dang rgyu tshogs kyi tshad/ rgyags yon gyi tshad snga ma ji lta ba bzhin la/ khyad par ni/ zla ba drug po'i ring gi gsol ja ma gtogs pa'i rgyags kyi cha la dgos pa rnams ji snyed pa/ dpon drung g.yung pa tshe dbang rgyal po'i thugs rgyud kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*/ dgongs pa zab mo bskang ba'i phyir du don grub rab brtan nas bsgrubs pa dang*/ yon stengs su phan pa gser zho bzhi bcu'i rtsis 'gro mdzad pa yin/ thugs ka'i thad na/ kha che paṇa chen gyis spyan drangs pa'i rje btsun byams pa pad sdong gi steng na bzhugs pa'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa can/ byang pa bdag po dkon mchog legs pa'i phyag nas/ mkhas grub don yod dpal ba dbus phyogs la thog mar phebs dus su phul ba'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa can de bzhugs/ yang thugs kha'i phyogs gcig na rnam rgyal mchod rten bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa can/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gdung tsha/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha bo sgang pa'i sku mchin gyi dum bu la ring srel gyis bltams pa bzhugs// //dge'o// // ༄// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ rab 'bar ye shes snang byed zer gyi rmongs pa'i nam rings snga bar langs byed de ni thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// de ston byed po bsod nams rgyas skrun mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rdzogs sangs rgyas yin des bstan pa ni lung dang rtogs pa'i chos// de 'dzin pa ni sdom brtson mkhas gang tshogs pa'i dge 'dun nyid yin de byon pa na de las 'bras bu rnam gsum 'byung*// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i nyin byed snang ba gang du 'char byed de ni glegs bam tshogs yin de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bde 'byung thod kyi zla rgyas lang tsho yis// dul bar btegs pa'i zhabs sen dmar 'od ni// bgrang yas 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// mnga' mdangs nyin mor byed pa'i gser mdog can// khyod gsung tshangs dbyangs brgya pa'i rnga sgra ni// phyogs las rnam rgyal 'jig med khang bzang du// tshogs gsum ri mor gsal ba 'di bzhugs kyi// tsa tur mu kha'i lag pas 'di zung zhig

/legs bshad skye mched mtshar ba'i mdzes sdug gis// gzur gnas dpyod chen yid kyi shing rta yang*// 'dren byed gsung rab kun la blta ba'i sgo// 'byed mkhas lugs brgya ldan pa 'di na bzhugs// zhes mchod par brjod nas/ mchog tu bsngags par 'os pa'i 'khor lo rin po che dag nyid la gnas shing rten nas/ phan pa dang bde ba ma lugs pa'i 'byung gnas thub bstan yid bzhin gyi nor bu ris med pa mtha' dag la ched cher 'dzin zhing*/ gces spras su bya ba lhur len pa'i skyes bu dam pa mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal gyis phyug pa ches rab tu mang po/ chu bo chen po rnam pa bzhi'i rgyun lta bu yang dang yang du nges par bsti ba'i gnas/ thub bstan gser mdog can zhes bya ba'i chos kyi grwa yangs po'i thog mar/ chos 'chad pa po gang na 'dug pa'i seng ge'i khri bde bar 'khod pa'i gtsug lag khang nye bar 'khor dang bcas pa na/ rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu mang po dag dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma dag la/ bka' bsgo gtad gnyer du phul nas bzhugs pa dag las/ re zhig thog mar gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs nas/ gsung rab mang po la blta ba dang rtog pa dag gis glegs bam btsal sla ba'i phyir du kha byang du btab nas mtshan gyi rnam grangs bkod pa la gsum ste/ dpe sna tshogs 'dus pa'i mtshan byang dang*/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro tshal gyi mtshan byang dang*/ bka' 'gyur ro tshal gyi mtshan byang bkod pa'o// dang po la mda' tshad du bzhugs pa rnams kyi dang*/ kha bras sogs su bkod pa rnams kyi'o// dang po ni/ ka pa la zhes sogs/ mjug tu// //swasti/ gzims khang ka gnyis ma na bzhugs pa'i phyag dpe'i tho yig deb ther 'di'i nang na ji ltar 'khod pa rnams/ spyir bstan pa bsrung ba'i rdo rje chos bsrung rnams dang*/ khyad par dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa 'khor bcas/ las mgon pu tra ming sring*/

gnod sbyin bha dra nag po/ gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad po rnams la bcol gtams drag po dang*/ gtad gnyer drag po bgyis bdog pas/ chos grwa 'di'i mtshams kyi phyi rol du mi 'da'/ mtshams nang du bzhugs nas gzigs rtog byed pa rnams la dpe gnyer bas do dam byas nas 'phral du gtong len byed dgos pa yin no// zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dmar nag 'bar ba'i gur khang du// hūm̐ phaṭa drag po'i 'brug sgra yis// ma rungs pa dag tshar bcad nas// dam chos bsrung ba'i las byos shig /ces bcol bas grub pa yin no// //maṅga laṃ// //bha wantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
